title: HiC Step Envelope v1
description: The single result shape every pipeline step returns (services/stepEnvelope.ts). Ported from deer-flow's deerflow_tool_meta. Consumers branch on nextAction and errorType; they never parse `message`. Adding an enum value is a MINOR change (older consumers see an unknown value); removing one is BREAKING.

value.description: Step output. Null on error; usually present on partial.

recoverableByModel.description: Whether another model attempt could fix this. Independent of status: an empty retrieval is an error AND recoverable; an auth failure is neither.

nextAction.description: narrow_scope is HiC-specific: ship less rather than fabricate.

message.description: Human-readable. Logged and shown in honest partials. NEVER parsed.

stopReason.description: ADDITIVE (deer-flow's own v1-compatibility lesson): older consumers that only read status keep working.
